title: Application of the online teaching model based on BOPPPS virtual simulation platform in preventive medicine undergraduate experiment
reason: Class-level experimental vs control comparison (BOPPPS plus virtual simulation platform vs traditional) of experiment-report scores, engagement and Biggs questionnaires by t-tests. Virtual-simulation scores are named but no per-student indicator is related to any outcome.

extraction.n_quote: The participants were 100 undergraduates of preventive medicine in Binzhou Medical University, class 2019.
extraction.lms_indicators: virtual simulation platform scores (named only; not analysed against outcomes)
extraction.outcome_or_construct: experiment report scores; student engagement scale; Biggs study process (deep/surface learning, self-report); teacher self-efficacy
extraction.notes: Group contrasts only (t and P values).
